76809.subject: Weekly Recap: Crypto Lost Its Rate Trade
76809.body:
**gm, Defiers!**

Crypto spent the week trading a rate path the new Fed chair declined to endorse. **Kevin Warsh** held at 3.50%-3.75% in a 9-3 vote where all three dissenters wanted a hike, opened his first press conference in the chair with "there is no soft inflation target," and left bitcoin behind the last stock rally of July. Bitcoin still closed the month up 4.3%, and it trailed the Nasdaq by five points on the final day.

Onchain, the revenue math moved faster than the macro. **Uniswap**'s fee switch reached v4 pools and nearly tripled protocol revenue, **Morgan Stanley** put staking yield inside two NYSE Arca wrappers, and **Metronome** found a $15.7 million hole where collateral was supposed to be.

Enjoy!

———————————————————————————

———————————————————————————

##### WATCH

## Memecoins Eat Everything: Robinhood's Accidental Casino & Base's Identity Crisis

Youtube: 🟢 LIVE: Memecoins Eat Everything: Robinhood's Accidental Casino & Base's Identity Crisis (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YYP1kJ5QZFA)

Robinhood built a chain for tokenized equities and spent its first month hosting a memecoin venue, while Base walked back its onchain-social bet over the same stretch. The Defiant team maps where retail flow actually went. Worth a second look now that Robinhood Chain is supplying more than half of Uniswap's new v4 revenue.

———————————————————————————

# Top Stories This Week

## Uniswap Protocol Revenue Nearly Triples After v4 Fee Switch as UNI Tops $4

**Uniswap** protocol revenue nearly tripled after Proposal 100 extended the fee switch to v4 pools on July 27, with [about $325,000 flowing toward UNI burns in 24 hours](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/uniswap-protocol-revenue-nearly-triples-after-v4-fee-switch-as-uni-tops-usd4) against roughly $114,000 a day earlier in the month, per DefiLlama. The proposal passed with 46.6 million UNI in favor and 1.27 million against, extending fees across seven chains. **Robinhood Chain** supplied $170,353 of the past day's revenue, more than half, and Ethereum mainnet added $81,866. UNI rallied 12% to about $4.40 and the dead address now holds 107.8 million tokens. Dromos Labs co-founder **Alexander Cutler** says holders of locked v2 and v3 liquidity lost up to 25% of their fee share; Uniswap co-founder **Hayden Adams** called that math made-up, saying v4 charges the trader on top of the LP's full rate. Roughly $3 billion in TVL stayed put through day three.

## Bitcoin Lags Stock Rally After Hawkish Fed Hold

Bitcoin fell 3.5% over 24 hours to $62,464 on Friday while the S&P 500 climbed 1.7% and the Nasdaq gained 2.8%, [leaving crypto out of July's closing rally](https://thedefiant.io/news/markets/bitcoin-lags-stock-rally-after-hawkish-fed-hold).
